content.what_it_is: Preprocessed (build/pre) Fortran source of FUNWAVE-TVD init.F with three subroutines. SUBROUTINE ALLOCATE_VARIABLES (L65-247, history L59-62: Shi 05/2010, Tehranirad varying cd 09/26/2013, Choi V4xL/U4yL/WAVEMAKER_VIS 08/06/2015): allocates all GLOBAL arrays — Xco/Yco coordinates (L69), the big block L71-152 (slopes DelxU..DelyHU; x/y interface L/R states UxL..HyR; cross/second/first derivatives Uxy..ETATy; time-derivative arrays U0..DVty; interface fluxes PL..EtaRyR; SPONGE/SpongeMaker; cell variables Fx,Fy,U,V,HU,HV,Gx,Gy,P,Q,SxL..SyR,SourceX/Y; statistics Umean..HavgSum; ykchoi ETA2sum/ETA2mean/SigWaveHeight L145-146; dispersion L/R states U4xL..U4yR L147-151), depth/mask block Depth,H,Depthx,Depthy,MASK,DepthNode,MASK_STRUC,MASK9,tmp4preview,Int2Flo,Cd,CD_breakwater (L153-159), updating variables Eta,Eta0,Ubar0,Vbar0,Ubar,Vbar (L161-163), dispersion updates U4..V3 (L165-167), HeightMax (L170-171), WaveMaker_Mass=ZERO (L173-174), WK_TIME arrays WAVE_COMP,Beta_genS,D_genS (L176-178), breaking arrays AGE_BREAKING,nu_break=nu_bkg,BreakSourceX/Y now allocated unconditionally (fyshi 01/15/2024 comment L186-194), FrcInsX/Y (L196), ROLLER_FLUX,UNDERTOW_U/V (L198), WAVEMAKER_VIS nu_break=ZERO (L200-203), DIFFUSION_SPONGE nu_sponge (L205-208), conditional output maxima HeightMin/VelocityMax/VorticityMax/MomentumFluxMax/ARRTIME (L210-229), and Salatin et al. 2021 (JGR Oceans, doi 10.1029/2021JC017641, citation L234-238) wavemaker index arrays xmk_wk,ymk_wk (L242). SUBROUTINE INITIALIZATION (L258-899, history L253-255): sets MUSCL kappa (Kappa=-1 for 'SEC' else 1/3, L275-279); zeroes ~130 arrays/counters (L282-444); builds Cartesian coordinates Xco/Yco from (iista-1)*DX/(jjsta-1)*DY (ykchoi Jan/23/2018 replacing npx/npy forms, L448-470); sets PLOT_COUNT=PLOT_INTV etc. (L481-484), DT=ZERO (L486); zeroes Gamma1/Gamma2 when Gamma3<=0 (linear shallow water, L488-493) or .NOT.DISPERSION (L495-500); sets fully-nonlinear Boussinesq coefficients a1=Beta_ref^2/2-1/6, a2=Beta_ref+1/2, b1=Beta_ref^2, b2=Beta_ref and Kennedy-equation Beta_1=Beta_ref+1, Beta_2=(1/5)^2/1 (L502-509); bathymetry by DEPTH_TYPE: 'DAT' GetFile(DEPTH_FILE) with existence check and MPI_FINALIZE+STOP on missing (L513-526), 'FLA' Depth=Depth_FLat (L528-535), 'SLO' global slope array VarGlob=Depth_Flat-SLP*(I-(INT(Xslp/DX)+1))*DX distributed via DISTRIBUTE_VarGlob (L538-553); ghost/mirror depth extension via PHI_COLL with VTYPE=1 (mirror bc rationale comments L558-562, L563-564); BATHY_CORRECTION CALL CORRECTION (L567-569); WaterLevel added to Depth, DEP_WK, Dep_Ser (03/29/2016, L572-577); interface depths DepthX(I,J)=0.5*(Depth(I-1,J)+Depth(I,J)) with extrapolated edges 0.5*(3*Depth(1,J)-Depth(2,J)) (L581-599); note L600-613 explains why depth reconstruction from depth_nod was removed (well-balanced scheme, fyshi 11/14/2016); blowup threshold EtaBlowVal=100*MAXVAL(|Depth|) reduced by MPI_ALLREDUCE MAX (L617-619); friction Cd from CD_FILE if IN_Cd else Cd_fixed (L621-630); INI_UVZ initial condition via INITIAL_UVZ with optional BED_DEFORMATION Depth=Depth-ETA (L634-644); initial-condition wavemakers INI_SOL/N_WAVE/INI_REC/INI_GAU/INI_DIP/INI_OTH calling INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE/INITIAL_N_WAVE/INITIAL_RECTANGULAR/INITIAL_GAUSIAN/INITIAL_DIPOLE/INITIAL_WAVE (L646-685); CALL WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION (L688); sponge setups CALCULATE_SPONGE/CALCULATE_DIFFUSION_SPONGE/CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE (with CD_4_SPONGE allocation)/CALCULATE_SPONGE_MAKER for ABS wavemaker (L691-721); initial wet/dry mask from Eta<-Depth setting Eta=-MinDepth-Depth (L725-736); H=MAX(Eta*Gamma3+Depth,MinDepthFrc), HU=H*U, HV=H*V (L738-740); CAL_DISPERSION if DISPERSION (L742-744); Ubar=HU+gamma1*U1p*H, Vbar likewise (L746-747); OBSTACLE file read into MASK_STRUC=INT(VarGlob) (L751-767); BREAKWATER: rank-0 reads BREAKWATER_FILE into global BreakWaterWidth with ghost-cell edge copying (L770-807), CALL CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER (L809); Depth=-LARGE where MASK_STRUC==0 (L816-822); MASK=MASK*MASK_STRUC (L824); MASK9 = product of the 9-point neighborhood of MASK (L826-832); PHI_INT_EXCH on MASK and MASK9 (L834-835); local depth flattening at dry-point interfaces (rationale comments L842-850 including Choi Thacker-bowl accuracy caveat and -DIGNORE_BIG_SLOPE Makefile option) (L851-860); T_brk=20.0_SP when SHOW_BREAKING (L862-864); Salatin et al. 2021 wavemaker acceleration block computing DXg=DX, DYg=DY, wavemaker index bounds ilo/ihi/jlo/jhi from xmk_wk/ymk_wk vs Xc_WK/Yc_WK footprint (L866-896). SUBROUTINE INITIAL_UVZ (L910-963, Shi 02/03/2011): INQUIRE existence checks for U_FILE/V_FILE (skipped when NO_UV_FILE)/ETA_FILE with MPI_FINALIZE+STOP (L916-940), GetFile U,V or U=V=ZERO (L942-948), GetFile ETA (L950), optional MASK_FILE read into rMASK and MASK=INT(rMASK) else MASK=1 (L952-961).

verbatim_spans.text: ! define breaking related variables for all options,remove viscosity breaking only
!      gamma3 = 0 means linear shallow water equation
! use mirror instead of continuous used before, date: 02/24/2019
! In Makefile, define -DIGNORE_BIG_SLOPE to ignore big slopes

unresolved: CHARACTER WHAT (L264) and INT2FLO/tmp4preview allocations (L157-158) are declared/allocated but not used in this file

nu_break is allocated twice when WAVEMAKER_VIS is true: unconditionally at L191 (=nu_bkg L192) and again inside IF(WAVEMAKER_VIS) at L201 (=ZERO L202) — a second ALLOCATE of an already-allocated array is a runtime error unless the compiler tolerates it; relation not resolvable in-file
U4xL/U4xR/V4yL/V4yR are zeroed (L361-364) but V4xL/V4xR/U4yL/U4yR allocated at L150-151 are not zero-initialized in INITIALIZATION — asymmetry with no in-file rationale
INITIALIZATION zeroes PLOT_COUNT=0 at L436 then overwrites PLOT_COUNT=PLOT_INTV at L481 (same for PLOT_COUNT_STATION L437/L482, SCREEN_COUNT L441/L484) — the first assignments are dead

the empty IF branches IF(Gamma3>ZERO)THEN/ELSE (L488-493) and IF(DISPERSION)/ELSE (L495-500) rely on comments only; Beta_ref, Gamma1-3, MinDepth, MinDepthFrc, LARGE, nu_bkg values come from GLOBAL/input (cross-file)
GetFile, DISTRIBUTE_VarGlob, PHI_COLL, PHI_INT_EXCH, CORRECTION, WAVEMAKER_INITIALIZATION, CALCULATE_* , INITIAL_* , CAL_DISPERSION, CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER are defined in other files (cross-file)

BREAKWATER read is rank-0 only (L784-807) and BreakWaterWidth is deallocated at L811 right after CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER — how non-zero ranks receive the width data must happen inside CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER (cross-file)
ilo/ihi/jlo/jhi are computed (L878-895) for the Salatin wavemaker speedup but consumed in source.F per comment L875 (cross-file)
